label: Assertion of selected content
definition: Asserts relates an agent to a content actually used in assertion. AssertionMade says that some agent stands in that relation to the selected content. The relation is primitive here; it has no built-in truth, sincerity or mental occurrence condition.
note: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Behavioral markers can overcount assertion, as the omission controls illustrate. Whether a public speech act, a quotation, or a machine-produced output counts as a genuine assertion is an interpretation question. The two relevant local constraints are kept in AssertedContentIsMeaningful and AssertionRealized.
